remaining_phase_processes.Name: powershell.exe
remaining_phase_processes.CommandLine:
"C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -Command "try { [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch {}
$backendAndSimulator = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'python.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'scripts/dev_backend.py|dev_simulator.py' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine; $viteNodes = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'chassis_management_platform.*vite' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine; $parents = foreach ($node in $viteNodes) { Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"ProcessId=$($node.ParentProcessId)\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine }; [pscustomobject]@{captured_at=(Get-Date).ToString('o');python=$backendAndSimulator;vite_nodes=$viteNodes;vite_parents=$parents} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content docs/verification/phase-04/runtime/shutdown_processes.json -Encoding utf8; foreach ($targetPid in @($backendAndSimulator + $viteNodes | ForEach-Object { $_.ProcessId } | Sort-Object -Descending)) { Stop-Process -Id $targetPid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; foreach ($targetPid in @($parents | ForEach-Object { $_.ProcessId } | Sort-Object -Descending)) { Stop-Process -Id $targetPid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; [pscustomobject]@{backend_port_open=(Test-NetConnection -ComputerName 127.0.0.1 -Port 8800 -InformationLevel Quiet);vite_port_open=(Test-NetConnection -ComputerName 127.0.0.1 -Port 5173 -InformationLevel Quiet);remaining_phase_processes=(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'scripts/dev_backend.py|dev_simulator.py|chassis_management_platform.*vite' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content docs/verification/phase-04/runtime/shutdown_result.json -Encoding utf8; Get-Content docs/verification/phase-04/runtime/shutdown_result.json -Raw"
